card.name: Time unit ending a dosing limit
card.fires_on: The time word (usually "hours", also "day" or "daily") that closes a frequency phrase such as "every 24 hours" or "once a day" in dosing instructions, especially after "do not use more than".

modes.label: Per-24-hours limits
modes.description: "hours" ends a maximum-use phrase for inhalers or patches.
modes.example: Do not use Umeclidinium ELLIPTA more than 1 time every 24<< hours>>.

modes.label: Once a day wording
modes.example: Apply the rivastigmine transdermal system once a<< day>>.

card.plain: It lights up on the time unit that finishes a "how often per day" instruction in dosing text.
